about: Log 394 held-out set, written 2026-10-09 before any run. Built along the capability sheet's typed attributes: for data unit, regulator kinds, sign, omics layers and input network, two near misses that change only that attribute and one control that keeps it supported; plus new U, P and C items.

items.core: a TF-gene network for every individual nucleus
items.prompt: We have single-nucleus RNA-seq from 30 kidney biopsies plus motif and protein interaction priors. We want a TF-gene regulatory network for every individual nucleus.

items.core: a co-expression network for each single cell
items.prompt: From droplet scRNA-seq of 5,000 lung cells, we want a separate gene co-expression network for each cell so we can compare cells.

items.core: a TF-gene network for every bulk biopsy
items.prompt: We have bulk RNA-seq from 30 kidney biopsies plus motif and protein interaction priors. We want a TF-gene regulatory network for every biopsy.

items.core: circular RNAs as regulators
items.prompt: We want a regulatory network in which circular RNAs act as the regulators of protein-coding genes, using our expression data and predicted circRNA targets.

items.core: chromatin remodelers as regulators
items.prompt: We want to infer which chromatin remodelers, such as SWI/SNF subunits, regulate which genes, as a remodeler-to-gene regulatory network from our expression data.

items.core: a TF and miRNA regulatory network
items.prompt: With expression from 95 liver samples, motif and protein interaction priors, and microRNA target predictions, we want one network of how TFs and microRNAs regulate genes.

items.core: activation versus repression for each patient separately
items.prompt: With expression, motif and protein interaction priors for 55 patients, we want patient-specific networks that say, for each patient, which TFs activate and which repress each target.

items.core: whether each microRNA up- or down-regulates its targets
items.prompt: We have expression and miRNA target predictions for 80 tumors. We want a signed network saying whether each microRNA up-regulates or down-regulates each target.

items.core: activation versus repression across the cohort
items.prompt: With expression from 120 colon samples plus motif and protein interaction priors, we want to know which TFs activate and which repress each of their targets.

items.core: one network over three omics layers
items.prompt: We measured transcriptome, proteome and metabolome in the same 75 patients. We want one partial-correlation network linking all three layers jointly.

items.core: a per-patient network over four omics layers
items.prompt: For 50 patients we have expression, methylation, copy number and proteomics. We want a separate network for each patient that models all four layers together.

items.core: one network between two omics layers
items.prompt: We measured the proteome and the metabolome in the same 75 patients. We want one partial-correlation network linking proteins and metabolites.

items.core: communities of a protein-protein interaction network
items.prompt: We have a large protein-protein interaction network for human kinases. We want to partition it into densely connected communities of proteins.

items.core: modules of a gene co-expression network
items.prompt: We built a weighted gene co-expression network from 110 samples. We want to split this gene-gene network into co-expression modules.

items.core: communities of a TF-gene regulatory network
items.prompt: We built a weighted TF-gene regulatory network from 110 samples. We want to split this network into communities of regulators and their target genes.

items.core: differentially accessible chromatin regions
items.prompt: We have ATAC-seq from 12 treated and 12 untreated samples. We want to find chromatin regions that become significantly more or less accessible after treatment.

items.core: a Kaplan-Meier survival comparison by one gene's expression
items.prompt: We want to split 300 patients by high versus low expression of one gene and compare their survival with Kaplan-Meier curves and a log-rank test.

items.core: cell clusters and marker genes from single-cell data
items.prompt: We have scRNA-seq of 12,000 tumor cells. We want to cluster the cells, annotate cell types and list marker genes for each cluster.

items.core: RNA secondary structure predictions
items.prompt: We have the sequences of 200 long non-coding RNAs. We want to predict their secondary structures and find conserved structural motifs.

items.core: normalized, batch-corrected methylation array data
items.prompt: We have raw methylation array data from four hybridization batches. We need to normalize the arrays and remove batch effects before any downstream analysis.

items.core: gene fusion calls from RNA-seq
items.prompt: We have RNA-seq from 60 sarcomas. We want to detect gene fusions and report which fusions recur across tumors.

items.core: mutational signatures
items.prompt: We have whole-genome mutation calls for 150 tumors. We want to extract mutational signatures and estimate each tumor's exposure to them.

items.core: population differentiation statistics
items.prompt: We genotyped 500 individuals from three populations. We want Fst between populations and to find loci under selection.

items.core: pathogenicity predictions for missense variants
items.prompt: We found 400 missense variants in patients. We want to predict which are likely pathogenic using conservation and structure-based scores.

items.core: Gene Ontology enrichment of a gene list
items.prompt: We have a list of 150 genes upregulated after infection. We want Gene Ontology term enrichment with adjusted p-values.

items.core: a deep learning model predicting drug response
items.prompt: With expression, motif and protein interaction priors for 140 cell lines, we want a TF-gene network for each cell line, and then a deep learning model that predicts drug response.

items.core: predicting the community of new genes
items.prompt: We have a TF-gene network from heart tissue. We want its communities of regulators and genes, and then to predict which community newly discovered genes would join.

items.core: a GWAS on the sex-specific co-expression
items.prompt: We want the gene-gene co-expression attributable to sex in 220 samples, adjusting for age, and then a GWAS on that sex-specific co-expression.

items.core: each TF's protein half-life
items.prompt: With expression of 70 patients plus motif and protein interaction priors, we want each TF's activity per patient, and then each TF's protein half-life.

items.core: designing antagomirs against the hub miRNA
items.prompt: With expression, motif, protein interaction and miRNA target priors for 90 tumors, we want a TF and miRNA network, and then to design antagomir sequences against its hub miRNA.

items.core: one TF-gene network for the cohort
items.prompt: We have RNA-seq from 250 breast tumors, a motif prior and a protein interaction network. We want one TF-gene regulatory network for the whole cohort.

items.core: per-sample co-expression networks with edge p-values
items.prompt: We have expression from 44 patients and no prior knowledge. We want a co-expression network for each patient with a p-value for each edge.

items.core: mutation-based patient subtypes
items.prompt: We have somatic mutation calls for 310 endometrial tumors. We want patient subtypes based on which pathways carry mutations.

items.core: per-patient two-layer networks compared between groups
items.prompt: We have methylation and expression for 100 patients, half of them relapsed. We want a two-layer network for each patient and to compare relapsed with non-relapsed patients.

items.core: a low-memory cohort TF-gene network
items.prompt: Our machine has limited memory. We need one TF-gene regulatory network for 500 samples from a motif prior and a protein interaction network.
